## 🎯 Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 **feat**: New component or feature
- [ ] 🐛 **fix**: Bug fix or patch
- [ ] 💥 **breaking**: Breaking API change or backward-incompatible update
- [ ] 📝 **docs**: Documentation updates or examples
- [ ] 🎨 **style**: Code styling, themes, or formatting
- [ ] ♻️ **refactor**: Code restructure without changing behavior
- [ ] ⚡ **perf**: Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 **test**: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] 🔧 **chore**: Tooling, build config, or dependency maintenance

## ✅ Verification Checklist
